integrity: The proof and explicit finite arithmetic verifier are provided. Existing classification of the rings, the sharp zero-divisor order bound, the generic CC-ring clique decomposition, and the generic isoclinism implication are acknowledged as prior results. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only nontrivial finite-field twists of square-zero one-radical-generator unital rings; it does not cover arbitrary finite chain rings, arbitrary radicals, higher nilpotency, or the identity twist. Finite tests cover only characteristic two and do not constitute an infinite proof. Historical equivalent fixed-field isoclinism results could exist under alternative terminology.
title: Fixed fields classify commutator structures of skew square-zero finite rings
